condition_continue.instructions: The camera view is clear and the robot gripper can continue its planned reach without an immediate obstacle.

condition_brake.instructions: The camera workspace is obscured, or the physical touch force exceeds 10 N during this open-gripper reach. Current touch [0.0, 9.962, 36.024] N.

condition_retreat.instructions: A separate human skin-colored hand or arm is very close to the robot gripper or entering its immediate path.

condition_lift.instructions: A solid yellow object blocks the robot gripper's immediate reach from below and lifting can avoid it.

condition_left.instructions: The green or turquoise circular target pad is visibly to image-left of the blue outlined planned landing point.

condition_right.instructions: The green or turquoise circular target pad is visibly to image-right of the blue outlined planned landing point.

arbitrate.instructions: Robot camera. Black gripper and white links are the ROBOT. Orange outline marks its gripper; green/turquoise pad is the reach target, blue outline its planned landing point. Touch force [0.0, 9.962, 36.024] N. Current motor watchdog_hold. The gripper stays open; yellow block is an obstacle. Select the immediate reflex appropriate to this actual view.
